Open Project Settings → Script Properties and copy ACSL_SHEETS_TOKEN. Use it only for the computer configuration below. Do not share it in chat, on GitHub, or with students.

Choose Deploy → New deployment → Select type → Web app. Set Execute as to Me and access to Anyone, then deploy. Copy the URL ending in /exec. The web app checks the secret token and does not publish the score sheet.
